17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1107 West Fulton Market, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: = DX-7 Downtown Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: 4,000 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to construct a two-story addition to the existing
four-story commercial-use building. The resulting building will measure
104 ft. in height and contain approximately 4,000 sq. ft. of retail space at
grade, 3,800 sq. ft. of office space on floors 2-4 (11,400 sq. ft. total), and
two (2) dwelling units above with a roof top deck. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location and will not provide any off-street parking.
Pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the off-street parking
requirement for a Transit Served Location to zero, reduce the rear setback
for floors containing residential units from 30 ft. to zero, and is seeking all
relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the attached Type 1 Plan Set.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 24,620 square feet (6.16 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 2,000 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (CTA Morgan Rail
Station). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the
required number of off-street parking spaces to zero.

(D) — Setbacks:
a Front Setback: zero
db. Side Setbacks:
West Side: zero
Wast Side: zero
c. *Rear Setback: Zero

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback
for floors containing residential uses from the required 30 ft. to zero.

(E) Building Height: 104 feet
